intro.title: Letter Combinations of Phone Number
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that generates all possible letter combinations from a string of digits, like those on a phone keypad. You'll learn how to use recursion or backtracking to explore all possible combinations systematically. The main technologies involved are JavaScript functions, arrays, and string manipulation. This exercise will help you understand how to solve combinatorial problems by breaking them down into smaller, manageable steps.
intro.usecase: This algorithm powers predictive text and autocomplete features in phone dialers and messaging apps, where pressing number keys generates possible word combinations. Developers implement it in interactive phone number input forms that suggest names or words as users type digits. It's also used in accessibility tools that convert telephone keypad inputs into text for users with motor impairments, and in security systems that generate passphrase combinations from numeric codes.
